code: const KEY="cyberraksha_token";const USER_KEY="cyberraksha_user";export function setAuth(token,user){localStorage.setItem(KEY,token);localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY,JSON.stringify(user));}export function getToken(){return localStorage.getItem(KEY);}export function getUser(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY)||"null");}catch(_unused){return null;}}export function logout(){localStorage.removeItem(KEY);localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);}
